faqSection.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqSection.subtitle: Clear and comprehensive answers to the most common questions
faqSection.q1: What is EDMN and how does it work?
faqSection.a1: EDMN is a financial mediation app that acts as a trusted third party between buyers and sellers. It holds funds in an escrow account until the buyer confirms receipt of what they purchased, then transfers the amount to the seller.
faqSection.q2: How does EDMN protect my money as a buyer?
faqSection.a2: Your money is held in a secure escrow account and is only transferred to the seller after you confirm receipt of the product or service as agreed. In case of a problem, EDMN's team intervenes to protect your rights.
faqSection.a3: EDMN's fees are competitive and transparent: 5% for individuals and 3% for merchants. No hidden fees — you know the full cost before confirming any transaction.
faqSection.q4: Is EDMN suitable for intangible services?
faqSection.a4: Yes! EDMN is also suitable for digital services, rentals, design, and programming. The app ensures you receive the service before the provider gets paid.
faqSection.q5: What happens if there's a dispute between buyer and seller?
faqSection.a5: EDMN's support team intervenes to review evidence and resolve the dispute fairly and impartially. Funds remain held until the dispute is resolved.
faqSection.a6: Yes, if the agreed product or service is not delivered, the buyer can request a refund according to our refund policy.
